de1.P1.C7.ghi_chu: Cac phuong an (4 do thi) khong co trong file de, chi co bang bien thien o hinh; dap an A trong de giu nguyen nhung khong doi chieu duoc voi phuong an. Thieu toan bo 4 phuong an (deu la hinh ve do thi) va hinh bang bien thien image14.png nen chua xac minh duoc dap an A da luu. Dac diem do thi can doi chieu: y = x^3-3x+2 = (x-1)^2(x+2), cuc dai (-1;4), cuc tieu (1;0), tiep xuc truc hoanh tai x=1, cat tai x=-2; can de goc (4 hinh phuong an) de chot chu cai.
